# SCI-FLT-MATCHED v0.1 r0.3 Science/Representation Crosswalk

Status: authority-separation repair; all affected routes remain unselected

| Object | Scientific-owner decision | Engineering declaration after science | Identity rule |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Weight `W_p` | Select concrete `AO-001-A` or C, commission a concrete successor under B/D, or declare unavailable | Implement only after exact science; preregister evidence and numerical profile | B/D are authorship triggers, not generic selectable weights. |
| Numerical producer | Exact `n_p/d_p` and any intentionally distinct successor science | `AO-002-A` exact-operator profile or `AO-002-C` unavailability | `F_g` is actual; an established `L-tilde_g` is recorded only when proved. |
| Named covariance role | `AO-003-A` complete, B named projected, or C unavailable; separately authorize U2/joint scope | `AO-003-D` resident/structured or E lineage/on-demand | Representation cannot change the role, scope, population, conditioning, or query answers. |
| Resolved immutable state | Fix finite scientific state queries within `Q_FLT^0.1` and each named use | `AO-004-A` full, B compact exact, or C exact lineage reconstruction | Every supported query is exact; a query outside the finite vocabulary requires a successor envelope. |
| Typed response | Fix fixed/FP/operational-realized/reference type, domain, validity, units, consumers, and finite queries | `AO-005-A` full, B exact structured, or C exact lineage/on-demand | Representation preserves response identity and exact query answers; unsupported queries are unavailable. |
| SCI-VAL verdict policy | Seven PA/SA/SP/CU/NU/RU/FH meanings, axes, dependencies, actions, and versions | `AO-006-A` separate records, B grouped records, or C seven-role vector | Layout is lossless only and cannot authorize an actionable scalar. |
| Template response | Source-domain reference, unit amplitude, parent response, anchor relation, sampling, phase, support, lineage, validity, and finite queries | Materialized, exact structured, or exact lineage/query reconstruction | A representation-only change does not alter template or amplitude estimand. |

The engineering comparison matrix in the Engineering Conformance Specification
records storage/query cost, reproduction dependencies, failure surface, and
audit burden for the representation alternatives. Storage footprint is
`S_store` and has no scientific authority.
